Blitzcrank.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. Blitzcrank’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, watch out for Blitzcrank’s grab and follow-up attacks, and don’t start fights with Milio. In mid game, managing your distance matters because Milio has no mobility ability, so avoid brush when moving through areas without vision. In late game, Milio’s shields and healing grow as you build items, and he excels in teamfights where your allied marksman can keep attacking.
Blitzcrank.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them consume Milio P Fired Up!’s bonus damage with a basic attack. If Blitzcrank closes in to retaliate, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and interrupt your ally’s attacks.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock Blitzcrank away if he engages on an ally. If several allies are caught by crowd control, use Milio R Breath of Life to provide healing, but don’t wait to use it in hopes of removing a knock-up.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to move forward and trade. Treat it as a safe window when Blitzcrank is out of mana and can’t use his grab, too. If Blitzcrank engages on an ally, knock him away with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved.
Blitzcrank.fight: Start trading by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally while your allied marksman is within attack range. Look for an opening right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he is low on mana, but save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock Blitzcrank away if he engages on an ally.
Blitzcrank.laning: Stay behind your allies and use minions as a shield. Only move forward after securing vision in the brush. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, push the lane or trade to gain an advantage. Watch Blitzcrank’s mana bar, and cast Milio W Cozy Campfire when your allied marksman starts attacking.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, it can lead into the knock-up from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Stand behind minions, and stay far from brush when you don’t have vision inside it. Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove a knock-up, so keeping your distance to avoid the grab comes first.

Alistar.fight: Start trades by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. If Alistar engages, use the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved to knock him away. Reposition and counterattack right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and fight again after it ends.
Alistar.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Alistar engages on an ally, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. You can still use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to interrupt Alistar’s engage after Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active. If several allies are caught by crowd control, use Milio R Breath of Life, but remember that it cannot cleanse the knock-up from Alistar Q Pulverize.
Alistar.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to withstand poke. Only move forward after securing vision in the brush. Cast Milio W Cozy Campfire when your allied marksman starts attacking to give them a range advantage. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to stop Alistar from engaging instead of using it to poke.
Alistar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Alistar deals mostly magic damage, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Alistar.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them use an empowered basic attack to consume Milio P Fired Up!'s bonus damage. Cast Milio W Cozy Campfire when your ally starts attacking, then use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock Alistar away when he closes in to retaliate.
Alistar.escape: The moment Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down is your window to close the distance and counterattack. After Alistar uses Alistar W Headbutt, confirm that Alistar Q Pulverize is down before going in. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to interrupt him when he tries to engage again.
Alistar.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and avoiding risky deaths rather than starting fights. In mid game, position yourself with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick ready to stop Alistar’s engage and Milio E Warm Hugs ready to protect allies. In late game, Milio is at his best in teamfights where your allied marksman can keep attacking from range.
Alistar.watch: Watch for Alistar W Headbutt into Alistar Q Pulverize to knock you up, followed by Alistar E Trample to stun you. Milio has no way to escape on his own, so keep your distance. Near a turret, don’t leave Alistar room to get behind you.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a straight line with an ally or minion. Watch your flanks, since Bard E Magical Journey can bring him in from the side. Bard R Tempered Fate grants damage immunity to both allies and enemies, so watch its area and timing.
Bard.phase: Early on, Milio has little kill participation and damage, so protect allies instead of forcing fights. In mid game, watch for Bard leaving lane and, with your allies, take advantage when Bard E Magical Journey is down. In late game, Milio’s shields and healing grow, so help your allied marksman keep attacking within attack range.
Bard.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard’s main damage is magic, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance. Tenacity is also important because being focused after a stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding is dangerous.
Bard.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to empower their next attack, then have them consume Milio P Fired Up! with a basic attack. If Bard closes in to retaliate, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire nearby when your allied marksman starts attacking to give them a range advantage.
Bard.escape: The moment Bard E Magical Journey is used is your chance to close the distance or pick him off. Approach after dodging the stun angle of Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and hit Bard with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick when he has no portal to escape through.
Bard.fight: Wait behind your allied marksman for a chance to counterattack instead of starting a fight with Milio. Just before trading, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. If Bard engages, knock him away with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved. Right after Bard E Magical Journey is down, look for a chance to close the distance and hit him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Bard.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke. Take a direct fight when you can use Milio W Cozy Campfire’s range advantage. Position away from walls and from straight lines with allies or minions so you can dodge Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Bard.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life to remove the immobilize and heal them. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who come through a portal and engage on your allies.

Brand.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke while holding the wave. Keep away from minions Brand has set on fire, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from them. Don’t cast Milio W Cozy Campfire early just for the healing; use it when your allied marksman can attack with the range advantage.
Brand.phase: Early on, Milio has little kill participation and damage, so protect allies instead of forcing fights. In mid game, make use of the growing shields and healing as you build items, and only take fights when Brand’s poke abilities are down. In late game, Milio excels in teamfights where your allied marksman can keep attacking from range.
Brand.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them consume Milio P Fired Up!’s bonus damage with a basic attack. If Brand closes in to retaliate, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and cut the trade short.
Brand.escape: The moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close the distance. If you aren’t burning, Brand Q Sear won’t stun you, so use that window too. Brand has no mobility ability, but Milio must protect his allies, so before using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to engage, check whether you can prevent a counterattack.
Brand.fight: When your ally can attack Brand, cast Milio E Warm Hugs to add its passive bonus damage. Look for an opening after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and there’s no risk of being stunned by Brand Q Sear. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and push Brand out of your ally’s range; save it to knock him away when he closes in to retaliate.
Brand.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand’s main damage is magic, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone to survive.
Brand.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. Spread out from burning allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. If several allies are immobilized, use Milio R Breath of Life to cleanse them, and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who engage on your allies.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, being hit by another ability makes the stacks build up and explode, so dodge his first ability. While you’re burning, watch for the stun from Brand Q Sear: dodge out of the projectile’s path or hide behind a minion. When Brand W Pillar of Flame marks an area, use Milio E Warm Hugs’ movement speed in advance to get out.

Hwei.fight: Start trading by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they can use an empowered basic attack. If Hwei retaliates or engages on an ally, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick and slow him. Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, your ally has a chance to close the distance, but Milio should not lead the engage.
Hwei.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke while holding the wave. Cast Milio W Cozy Campfire when your allied marksman starts attacking so they can use the increased range. If Hwei’s first ability hits, don’t stay in place; move before the second ability lands.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and avoiding risky deaths rather than starting fights. In mid game, go around paths Hwei has blocked with ground effects and eyes, and help allies move with Milio E Warm Hugs. In late game, as Milio’s shields and healing grow with items, look for teamfights where your allied marksman can keep attacking.
Hwei.escape: The moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your ally’s window to engage. Follow them while giving them movement speed with Milio E Warm Hugs, but don’t lead the engage while Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available.
Hwei.build: Start by buying Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the damage, then choose Mercury's Treads. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so Milio should build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of persistent crowd control, fit Mikael's Blessing in between core items.
Hwei.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them consume Milio P Fired Up!’s bonus damage with a basic attack. If Hwei closes in to retaliate, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to end the trade. Using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first can push the enemy out of your ally’s range.
Hwei.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. If Hwei E Subject: Torment catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life to remove the immobilize and heal them. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick until you need to knock away an enemy who engages on your main damage dealer.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you’re likely to be hit by the follow-up ability too. If the first ability hits, use Milio E Warm Hugs’ movement speed to reposition immediately and dodge the second. Watch out for the maximum-health damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster as well, and go around dangerous paths covered by ground effects.

Karma.fight: Start the trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their next attack is empowered. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, engaging first can leave your ally caught, so create distance to bait it out, then fight after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E expires. Don't use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first; use it to knock Karma away when she engages on an ally to retaliate.
Karma.laning: Don't stand in front. Stay behind your allies, use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb Karma's poke, and maintain the wave. If you take Karma's abilities for free, she'll be able to use R Mantra more often, so reposition to dodge them. Take a head-on fight when Milio W Cozy Campfire can increase your ADC's range.
Karma.phase: Milio has low kill participation and damage early, so focus on surviving Karma's poke without dying. In the mid game, protect your allies with the shields and healing that grow stronger as you build items. Milio is strongest in late-game teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking.
Karma.escape: Bait Karma into using W Focused Resolve, then time your allies' engage while her root is down. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, delay your burst until it expires. Watch out for the movement speed from Karma E Inspire, and don't go deep first since Milio has no ability to escape on his own.
Karma.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Karma's magic damage in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Magic resistance is fully effective against Karma's magic damage, but when she uses Karma W Focused Resolve, breaking the tether to avoid the root comes first. If the enemy team has lots of persistent crowd control, fit Mikael's Blessing between core items for another cleanse.
Karma.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their next attack carries Milio P Fired Up! If Karma retaliates and engages, knock her away from your ally with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire near your ADC when they start attacking.
Karma.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. If an ally is rooted by Karma W Focused Resolve, use Milio R Breath of Life to cleanse the immobilizing effect and heal them. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who engage on your allies.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows in an area, so dodge it by moving behind minions or out of range. If you're hit by the circle left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move out before it detonates again a moment later. If you're tethered by Karma W Focused Resolve, use the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs to create distance before the root lands.

Lulu.laning: Standing behind your allies with a minion between you can help you avoid some of the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Keep up steady pressure by using Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke instead of trying to take down Lulu and her partner all at once. Don't cast Milio W Cozy Campfire early just for the healing; use it to give your ADC a range advantage when they attack.
Lulu.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away anyone who engages on an ally. You can't cleanse the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth with Milio R Breath of Life, so use it after several allies are caught for the healing and tenacity.
Lulu.escape: Once Lulu W Whimsy has been used on another ally, you have a chance to close the distance. Lulu has no dash to escape, but Milio also has no ability to escape on his own, so don't move in first. When an ally engages on Lulu, help with Milio E Warm Hugs and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away anyone who engages on your ally.
Lulu.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Lulu's magic damage in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first, but decide on later resistances based on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting.
Lulu.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they make an attack carrying Milio P Fired Up! If the enemy retaliates and engages, knock them away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first can knock the enemy out of your ally's range and disrupt the trade.
Lulu.fight: Rather than engaging first as Milio, start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. When Lulu retaliates and engages as your ally attacks, knock her away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Once Lulu W Whimsy has been used on another ally, you can help your team find a chance to close the distance.
Lulu.phase: Milio has low damage and kill participation early, so focus on keeping your allies alive and maintaining the wave instead of forcing a head-on fight. In the mid game, be careful about committing to a fight all at once while Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth are available. As you build items, your shields and healing grow stronger, and Milio has the biggest impact in late-game teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences and prevents you from attacking, so don't close the distance while she still has it available. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so don't commit expecting to secure a kill on a target while Lulu R is available. Watch out for the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance, and use the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs to create room to dodge.

Maokai.fight: Don't close the distance first as Milio while Maokai W Twisted Advance is available. Right after you dodge Maokai W Twisted Advance, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to start a trade. If Maokai engages on an ally, knock him away with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you've saved.
Maokai.phase: In the early game, watch out for Maokai's root and dash, and don't force a fight as Milio. In the mid game, choose an opening when Maokai W Twisted Advance is down. As you build items, Milio's shields and healing grow stronger, so look for late-game teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, so don't enter its range near bushes while it's available. Don't enter bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has been placed. If a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of your allies. When Maokai R Nature's Grasp approaches from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path and avoid fighting in narrow corridors.
Maokai.combo: Just before a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their basic attack carries Milio P Fired Up! If Maokai retaliates and engages, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Maokai can't be targeted while dashing with W Twisted Advance, so hit him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick after he lands.
Maokai.build: Maokai's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first with a Null-Magic Mantle in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Choose later resistances based on the enemy carry who can deal damage while Maokai holds someone in place. If the enemy team has lots of persistent crowd control, fit Mikael's Blessing between core items.
Maokai.escape: The moment after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down is your chance to move forward or catch Maokai out. If you go in then and hit him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick, he'll have a hard time escaping. If Maokai W Twisted Advance is still available, manage the distance with the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs.
Maokai.laning: Stay behind your allies, use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke, and maintain the wave. Only move forward after securing vision in the bushes, and trade when Maokai W Twisted Advance is down. Take a head-on fight when your ADC can use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp roots several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life to heal and cleanse them.

Nami.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they can attack with the passive’s bonus damage. If Nami’s side retaliates and closes in, peel them off with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If Nami Q Aqua Prison catches several allies, respond with Milio R Breath of Life, but it cannot cleanse the knock-up from Nami R Tidal Wave.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is an opportunity to target her. Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. After they make an empowered attack, if the enemy closes in, knock them back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and knock Nami out of your ally’s attack range.
Nami.laning: Stay behind your allies, absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs, and hold the wave. Don’t cast Milio W Cozy Campfire early just for the healing; activate it when your allied ADC starts attacking. Secure vision before looking for an angle toward Nami, and don’t stay up front for long.
Nami.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies. If Nami’s crowd control catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life to heal and cleanse them, but it cannot remove the knock-up from Nami R Tidal Wave.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns, so sidestep when you see its drop indicator. Nami R Tidal Wave travels from far away but moves slowly, so sidestep as soon as you see it and watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Don’t fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; engage again after its duration ends.
Nami.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami deals mostly magic damage, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nami.escape: Close the distance as soon as Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave, and wait for Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing to end on its target. Use the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs to approach, and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick if you expect an enemy to close in on an ally.
Nami.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and dodging Nami’s poke and crowd control instead of starting fights. In mid game, Milio’s shields and healing grow stronger as he builds items. In late game, teamfights where your allied ADC can keep attacking from within range are a strong situation for Milio.

Nautilus.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to sustain. Only move forward after securing vision in the bushes. Block Nautilus Q Dredge Line with a minion, and don't stay long within range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow. Take a head-on fight when your ADC can use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire.
Nautilus.phase: In the early game, don't start fights as Milio; survive while keeping your allies alive. In the mid game, use the shields and healing that grow stronger as you build items. In the late game, look for teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking with the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. If Nautilus engages on an ally, knock him away with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you've saved. If Nautilus's crowd control catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life, but don't stand on top of your allies since it can't cleanse the knockup from Nautilus R Depth Charge.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so dodge it by keeping a minion between you. Don't stay within basic attack range, where you can be rooted by Nautilus P Staggering Blow. Nautilus R Depth Charge knocks up its target and allies along its path, so don't stand on top of your allies while his ultimate is available.
Nautilus.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then let them use an empowered basic attack. If Nautilus retaliates and engages, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don't use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and knock him out of your ally's attack range.
Nautilus.build: Nautilus's main damage is magic, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If crowd control remains a problem, fit Mikael's Blessing between core items.
Nautilus.escape: The moment after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to close the distance and trade. When his engage tool is down, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick so he'll have a hard time engaging again.
Nautilus.fight: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them make an empowered attack before starting the trade. If Nautilus engages, knock him away from your ally with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you've saved. After Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, look for a chance to trade while keeping your distance.

Neeko.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with allies, but save one charge for an expected fight. If Neeko engages, knock her away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs or another ability catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life to heal and cleanse them. Milio R Breath of Life can't cleanse the knockup from Neeko R Pop Blossom, so don't wait to remove that effect.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up when it hits something first, making it easier for it to root allies behind the first target. Don't stand on top of your allies. If Neeko disappears from vision and an unexpected enemy approaches, suspect Neeko P Inherent Glamour and spread out in advance. When you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, leave its area. If Neeko is disguised, you may not see the windup when she engages, so create distance earlier.
Neeko.laning: Milio is fragile early and has no ability to escape on his own, so stay behind your allies and survive with Milio E Warm Hugs and Milio W Cozy Campfire. Spread out so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't root you and your allies together, and only move forward after checking vision in the bushes. Don't use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick for poke; save it for when Neeko engages.
Neeko.phase: Milio has low kill participation and damage early, so don't force an engage. In the late game, Milio's shields and healing grow stronger, so look for teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking.
Neeko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Neeko's main damage is magic, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom follows, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have their basic attack consume Milio P Fired Up! When your ally starts attacking, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and knock Neeko away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick if she engages. If you use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first, you may knock the enemy out of your ally's attack range.
Neeko.escape: Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down, your ally has a chance to trade, but help by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on them and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick for the counterattack.
Neeko.fight: When your ADC starts attacking, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire. Just before a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs to add Milio P Fired Up! to their next attack. If Neeko retaliates and engages, knock her away with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you've saved. Even while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down, create room for your allies to attack safely instead of stepping forward first as Milio.

Rakan.escape: The moment Rakan W Grand Entrance misses or is used is your opening to close the distance. Especially if Rakan is separated from his allies, he can’t dash to them with Rakan E Battle Dance, so use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick then to knock him back and try to slow him.
Rakan.laning: Milio has no mobility ability, so manage your distance and brush vision from behind your allies. Absorb Rakan’s poke with Milio E Warm Hugs, and only take a direct fight when you can use Milio W Cozy Campfire’s increased range. Avoid trading while the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is active.
Rakan.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Rakan closes in on an ally, peel him off with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved. If Rakan R The Quickness catches several allies, free them with Milio R Breath of Life, but it cannot cleanse the knock-up from Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Rakan.build: Rakan deals mostly magic damage, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Withstand his damage early with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Rakan.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. After they make an empowered attack, if Rakan retaliates and closes in, knock him back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If you use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first, Rakan will be pushed out of your ally’s range and interrupt the trade.
Rakan.fight: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them make an empowered attack before starting the trade. If Rakan closes in, peel him off your ally with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved. Immediately after Rakan W Grand Entrance has been spent, you have an opportunity to close the distance.
Rakan.phase: Early on, Milio has difficulty starting fights, and if Rakan’s engage catches you, you’re vulnerable to follow-up hits, so focus on survival and managing your distance. In mid game, keep protecting allies and avoid risky engages. In late game, Milio’s strength grows in teamfights where the allied ADC can keep attacking.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks up at its landing point, so sidestep when he starts dashing. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, don’t line up with your allies, and knock him back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick before he reaches you.

Renata.laning: Stay behind your allies, absorb Renata Glasc’s poke with Milio E Warm Hugs, and hold the wave. Activate Milio W Cozy Campfire when your allied ADC starts attacking to make use of the range advantage. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to poke; save it to peel enemies off your allies.
Renata.phase: Both champions have relatively low health and attack damage early, so Milio shouldn’t force a fight. In mid game, use Milio W Cozy Campfire’s increased range and Milio E Warm Hugs’ shield from a position where your allies can attack. Once your items are built in late game, Milio’s shields and healing grow stronger, so look for teamfights where your allied ADC can keep attacking.
Renata.teamfight: When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, spread out from your allies as you engage, and have any affected ally immediately use their crowd control removal if they have one. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire near your main damage dealer to increase their range, and share Milio E Warm Hugs without using all of it at once. Use Milio R Breath of Life if several allies are caught, and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off your main damage dealer.
Renata.escape: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, it’s a better time to engage than when you have to close the distance while watching out for its root. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so she has difficulty escaping if your ally closes in. You can hit her with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick then, but also consider whether you need to save it to peel an enemy off an ally.
Renata.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Renata Glasc deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If crowd control remains a constant threat, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items to add another way to protect your team’s main damage dealer.
Renata.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. After they make an empowered attack, use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick on the enemy that retaliates and closes in. If you use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first, the enemy may be pushed out of your ally’s range and interrupt the trade. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire near your allied ADC the moment they start attacking.
Renata.fight: Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to empower their next attack. If the enemy retaliates and closes in, peel them off with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Even when you have an opportunity to close the distance on Renata Glasc, protect and fight from behind your allies instead of leading the way.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots only the first target, so stand behind minions or your frontline. If it hits you, watch out for being thrown toward your allies and stunned. Sidestep Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, leave space between allies to reduce the damage they deal to each other after being hit.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness pierces targets and travels in a straight line, so avoid the line between Senna and a minion or ally in front of her. If Senna W Last Embrace hits you and marks you, move away from your allies before the root so you aren’t caught together. If you’ve been hit once, retreat so you don’t give Senna mist with a second attack.
Senna.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they can make a basic attack empowered by Milio P Fired Up! If Senna retaliates and gets close, end the trade by knocking her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and push Senna out of your ally’s range.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses, you have an opportunity to close the distance without worrying about its root. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, camouflaged enemies may approach with her, so retreat and look for another angle from a place with vision. Milio should help allies attack with Milio E Warm Hugs and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick for protection instead of stepping forward to engage first.
Senna.phase: Senna has low health and attack damage early, but Milio is also weak at fighting up front, so keep allies alive while disrupting Senna’s soul collection. In mid game, keep watching soul locations and dodge Senna’s second attack so she can’t collect mist. In late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow, but Milio’s shields and healing grow too, so help your allied ADC keep attacking.
Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna deals mostly physical damage, and Milio has low armor, so build armor first.
Senna.fight: Just before a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them start with an attack empowered by Milio P Fired Up! If Senna retaliates and closes in, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Only take a direct fight when you can use Milio W Cozy Campfire’s increased range.
Senna.laning: Stay behind your allies, provide shields and healing, and dodge the straight line from Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Watch the locations of souls in advance to create opportunities for your allies to poke when Senna moves up to collect them. Avoid Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if it hits, create distance from your allies.
Senna.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Senna W Last Embrace catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies. When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to secure vision or use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick’s area effect to deter enemies from approaching.

Seraphine.combo: Start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have them use a basic attack to deal Milio P Fired Up!'s bonus damage. If Seraphine closes in to counterattack, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don't use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and push her out of your allies' attack range.
Seraphine.escape: Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, you have a chance to close the distance. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so if you approach to a distance from which your allies can attack, you can catch her with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. However, Milio also has no ability to escape on his own, so don't use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to engage if you need it to protect an ally.
Seraphine.laning: Milio has no mobility ability, and standing in front is dangerous, so shield and heal from behind your allies. Use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb Seraphine's poke while keeping the wave steady. Take a straight fight when Milio W Cozy Campfire can extend your allies' attack range.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots targets that are already slowed and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, move out of its path, and use Milio E Warm Hugs's movement speed before it hits to give yourself room to dodge. Seraphine R Encore's range increases each time it hits an ally, so don't line up in team fights.
Seraphine.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads. Most of Seraphine's damage is magic, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Seraphine.fight: Right after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop, you have a chance to trade if Seraphine is separated from allies. Instead of leading the way, use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to help them attack. If Seraphine closes in to counterattack, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Seraphine.phase: Milio has low kill participation and damage early, so keep allies alive instead of forcing fights. In the mid game, support allies with shields and healing, and look for an opening when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. In the late game, Milio excels in team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking from extended range once you have more items.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their attack range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley slows in a cone, so dodge sideways and cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally before it hits to increase their movement speed. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed by each basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision. If several allies are stunned, respond with Milio R Breath of Life.
Ashe.build: Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Milio has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Ashe.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to apply Milio P Fired Up!, then have them consume it with a basic attack. If the enemy retaliates by closing in, knock them away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first can push Ashe out of your allies’ attack range and end the trade.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no ability to create distance on her own, so the moment Ashe W Volley is down is your chance to approach. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, keep your distance until it ends.
Ashe.fight: Right after Ashe W Volley is down, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and start trading. After your ally uses a basic attack empowered by Milio P Fired Up!, knock the enemy away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick if they close in. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, and fight again once it ends.
Ashe.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb Ashe’s poke. Dodge Ashe W Volley sideways and trade right after it is down. Take a direct fight when Milio W Cozy Campfire can extend your allies’ range.
Ashe.phase: Early on, Milio is weak at starting fights, so endure Ashe’s poke and avoid risky skirmishes. In mid game, keep protecting allies and extending their range. In late game, Milio’s strengths grow in teamfights where your allied marksman can keep attacking.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow catches several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who engage on your allies.

Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so help your allies close the distance from the side with the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick carelessly before you may need it to protect an ally.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don’t trade directly in front of his turrets; change your angle from the side or through brush. When your ally can attack Heimerdinger himself, help with the trade using Milio E Warm Hugs. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away an enemy who closes in to retaliate and engage on your ally.
Heimerdinger.laning: Stay behind your allies and use Milio E Warm Hugs to block poke while holding the wave. Don’t cast Milio W Cozy Campfire early just for the healing; use it for the range increase when your allied marksman starts attacking. Dodge the center of Heimerdinger’s grenade, and if it hits you, don’t stay within turret range.
Heimerdinger.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger’s turret, rocket, and grenade damage is all magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Heimerdinger.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then start trading after they attack with Milio P Fired Up! applied. If the enemy closes in to retaliate, knock them away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If your ally can keep attacking during the fight, place Milio W Cozy Campfire on the ground near them to extend their range.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and avoiding risky deaths rather than starting fights. In late game, Milio’s best teamfights are those where your allied marksman can keep attacking from range.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs as needed, but save one charge if a fight is expected. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away an enemy who engages on an ally.
Heimerdinger.watch: If you’re hit by a grenade, move out of turret range. Once Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, watch out for empowered grenades and rockets, and don’t group up in narrow passages.

Lux.phase: Milio has low kill participation and damage early, so don't force fights; keep your allies alive. In the mid game, keep dodging Lux Q Light Binding and hold your allies' ground so they can attack. In the late game, Milio's shields and healing grow stronger, so help your ADC keep attacking within range.
Lux.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. Don't group up with allies where Lux E Lucent Singularity can catch you all. If Lux Q Light Binding catches several allies, free them with Milio R Breath of Life, and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who engage on your allies.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two targets it hits, so don't stand in a line with your allies. If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up abilities and basic attacks that trigger Lux P Illumination are also dangerous, so get out of her basic attack range. Dodge sideways when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux's main damage is magic, and Milio tends to have low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they deal the bonus damage from Milio P Fired Up! with a basic attack. Close the distance after Lux Q Light Binding misses, then disrupt Lux with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If you use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first in a trade, Lux may be knocked out of your ally's attack range.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to approach. Avoid the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed, and use the fact that Lux has no movement ability to create distance to escape to close in.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it to create an opening for your ally to attack. Start the trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to apply Milio P Fired Up!, then have them use a basic attack. Once you've closed the distance to Lux, use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to disrupt her movement.
Lux.laning: Stay behind your allies, use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb Lux's poke, and maintain the wave. Lux Q Light Binding can hit an ally and continue to hit you, so stand offset from your allies. Take a head-on fight when Milio W Cozy Campfire can increase your allies' attack range.

Pantheon.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so avoid giving him kills and buy time. In mid game, keep protecting allies and survive until late game instead of starting fights. In late game, Pantheon’s influence falls off, and Milio grows stronger in teamfights where your allied ADC can keep attacking.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with the allies who need it. If Pantheon leaps onto an ally, peel him off with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved. Use Milio R Breath of Life if crowd control catches several allies, and also use it when healing is needed even if there is nothing to cleanse.
Pantheon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to withstand his damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon deals mostly physical damage, and Milio has low armor, so build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Pantheon.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. After they make an empowered attack, knock Pantheon back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick if he closes in. If you use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first, Pantheon may be pushed out of your ally’s range and interrupt the trade. If Pantheon W Shield Vault catches several allies, provide a cleanse and healing with Milio R Breath of Life.
Pantheon.escape: Don’t engage just because Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Look for an opening when Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also unavailable, then knock Pantheon back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Pantheon.fight: Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they can make an empowered attack. If Pantheon closes in on an ally with Pantheon W Shield Vault, knock him back with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved. Activate Milio W Cozy Campfire when your allied ADC starts attacking so they can use its range advantage.
Pantheon.laning: Keep a minion between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear when he uses it to poke, and secure vision in the brush before stepping forward. Absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs, but save one charge for Pantheon’s engage.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so don’t give him enough range to leap to you rather than trying to dodge it. Keep a minion between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear when he uses it to poke. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces, so wait for it to end instead of attacking from the front.

Janna.phase: Milio has low damage and kill participation early, so survive while keeping your allies alive instead of forcing fights. In the mid game, don't spend both charges of Milio E Warm Hugs before a fight. In the late game, Milio's shields and healing have a big impact in teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking within range.
Janna.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and give Milio E Warm Hugs to allies who need it. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who engage on your main carry. Use Milio R Breath of Life when several allies are caught or need healing, but don't hold it to cleanse the knockup from Janna Q Howling Gale.
Janna.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to survive first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna's damage is mostly magic, and Milio tends to have low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first if you're adding resistances.
Janna.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their next basic attack deals the bonus damage from Milio P Fired Up! If the enemy retaliates and engages, knock them away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire on the ground near your ADC when they start attacking.
Janna.escape: You have a chance to close the distance after Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon are down and the shield from Janna E Eye Of The Storm is gone. Rather than stepping forward to engage first as Milio, support your allies' attacks with Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio E Warm Hugs, and save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock away enemies who come close.
Janna.fight: Just before a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to use the bonus damage on their next attack and the shield. After your ally attacks, knock away anyone who retaliates and engages with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Instead of dumping damage all at once into a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm, wait until the shield is gone.
Janna.laning: Stay behind your allies, use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke, and maintain the wave. Harass the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then look for an opening after Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr miss. Take a head-on fight when Milio W Cozy Campfire can increase your allies' attack range.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks up enemies, and the longer she charges it, the farther it travels and the longer the knockup lasts. If you hear the tornado from a bush or out of vision, move out of its path. Janna R Monsoon knocks nearby enemies away and breaks up fights, so don't force an engage while her R is available.

Leona.laning: Stay behind your allies and support your ADC with Milio E Warm Hugs and Milio W Cozy Campfire. Only move forward after securing vision in the bushes. Don't stand in a line with your ADC, so Leona E Zenith Blade can't reach a deeper target. Take a head-on fight when your ADC can use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire, and counterattack after Leona's engage ability is down.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don't stand in a line with your allied ADC. Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so watch the distance she can cover rather than whether she has used the ability. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center. When Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its radius before it explodes.
Leona.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Leona's main damage, but also consider the damage type of the enemy carry who can deal damage while Leona holds someone in place. If the enemy team has lots of persistent crowd control, fit Mikael's Blessing between core items to give your main carry a way to cleanse it.
Leona.combo: For a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to apply Milio P Fired Up!, let the ally attack, then knock Leona away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick if she engages. If you use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first, you may knock the enemy out of your ally's attack range, so save it to stop an engage. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire on the ground near your ADC when they start attacking the enemy frontline.
Leona.escape: The moment after Leona E Zenith Blade is down is your chance to close the distance and counterattack. If you knock Leona away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick then, she will have a hard time engaging again right away. Before Leona's crowd control catches your ally, use the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs to help them create distance.
Leona.fight: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they make an attack carrying the bonus damage from Milio P Fired Up! When Leona uses E Zenith Blade to engage, knock her away from your ally with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you've saved. Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down, you can close the distance with your ally and counterattack.
Leona.phase: In the early game, watch out for Leona's chain crowd control and avoid forcing fights. In the mid game, keep Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to stop engages and protect your allies. In the late game, use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire, shields, and healing to set up teamfights where your ADC can keep attacking.
Leona.teamfight: Stay behind your main carry, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs with your allies. If Leona engages on an ally, knock her away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Back off when you see Leona P Sunlight marks.

Morgana.fight: Stay at a distance behind your allies instead of stepping forward to start a fight. Just before a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. After they attack, if Morgana closes in, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don’t waste Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick’s forced movement on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Move along a line that overlaps the minion wave so minions can block Morgana Q Dark Binding. Use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke, and only take a direct fight when you can use Milio W Cozy Campfire’s increased range. Don’t use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to poke in lane; save it to peel enemies off your allies.
Morgana.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles catches several allies, free and heal them with Milio R Breath of Life. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies, but don’t use it on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand her damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Morgana deals mostly magic damage, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If you expect repeated crowd control, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items so you have another way to free allies besides Milio R Breath of Life.
Morgana.combo: Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they can make an empowered attack. If the enemy retaliates and closes in, knock them back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. When your allied ADC follows up, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire. If Morgana E Black Shield is active, wait for it to end before looking for forced movement.
Morgana.escape: After dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding, look for an opening when Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no way to create distance on her own, so you can keep her in range by hitting Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick then. If Morgana R Soul Shackles attaches, use the movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs to move out of range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.phase: Early on, focus on keeping allies alive and dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding instead of starting fights or looking for kills. In mid game, build items that increase your shielding and healing, but save Milio R Breath of Life for Morgana’s roots and stuns. In late game, Milio is strongest in teamfights where your allied ADC can keep attacking from within range.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding catches the first target it hits, so move with a minion between you and her. Morgana R Soul Shackles stuns after the chains attach, so move out of range as soon as you see them.

Rell.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and avoiding death to Rell’s engage rather than starting fights. In mid game, watch for Rell’s engage abilities to go down. In late game, Milio is at his strongest in teamfights where he helps the allied ADC keep attacking.
Rell.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm. Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. Peel Rell off anyone she reaches with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If Immobilizing effects catch several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life, but don’t expect it to cleanse the knock-up from Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Rell.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand her damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rell deals mostly magic damage, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rell.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their basic attack consumes Milio P Fired Up!'s bonus damage. If Rell retaliates and closes in, peel her off your ally with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Rell.escape: Create distance right after Rell uses Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, leaving her isolated. If Rell E Full Tilt is also down and hasn’t come back up, you have an opportunity to knock her back and slow her with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Rell.fight: Start a trade with Milio E Warm Hugs when your ally can attack, and knock Rell back with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved if she closes in. After Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down, create distance, and look for an opening before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up.
Rell.laning: Stay behind your allies, absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs, and hold the wave. While Rell is mounted, stay outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range. Secure vision in the brush before stepping forward.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally, Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down may follow, so stop trading and retreat out of its range. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so sidestep it and use Milio E Warm Hugs afterward.

Pyke.laning: Stay at a distance behind your allies, and only step forward after securing vision in the brush. Pyke can heal when he is out of sight, so maintain vision along his retreat path after a trade. Don’t cast Milio W Cozy Campfire early just for the healing; activate it for the range increase when your allied ADC attacks.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, increase their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Pyke closes in on an ally, peel him off with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If Pyke E Phantom Undertow stuns an ally, use Milio R Breath of Life. Don’t stand beside low-health allies, so you can avoid the damage and chain executions from Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.build: Withstand his damage with Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pyke deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first, then also get health while accounting for his penetration and the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally. After they make an empowered basic attack, if Pyke retaliates and closes in, knock him back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to finish the trade, since using it first could push the enemy out of your ally’s attack range.
Pyke.escape: After sidestepping Pyke E Phantom Undertow and avoiding its stun, you have an opportunity to respond. Pyke can also move with Pyke R Death From Below, so don’t engage just because Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down. If Pyke R Death From Below is also unavailable, respond by knocking him back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Pyke.fight: Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so they can make an empowered basic attack. If Pyke closes in, knock him away from your ally with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved. Continue the fight after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow.
Pyke.phase: Early on, Milio should keep allies alive and avoid risky deaths instead of starting fights. In mid game, stay with your allies and watch for Pyke’s pulls and executions. In late game, Milio’s shields and healing grow stronger, and he excels in teamfights where the allied ADC can keep attacking. Keep squishy allies behind the frontline and protect them.
Pyke.watch: If you’re pulled by Pyke Q Bone Skewer, Pyke E Phantom Undertow can follow up with a stun, so keep your distance. When Pyke dashes, sidestep the direction he came from. If you see a shark shadow beneath you while he is submerged, retreat toward an ally or turret.

Sona.laning: Trade repeatedly early, before Sona builds stacks, to make her spend mana on healing. Don't stand in front; absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs from behind your allies. Take a straight fight when you can use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire.
Sona.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads. Sona's main damage is magic, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Sona.combo: Use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have them use a basic attack to deal Milio P Fired Up!'s bonus damage. If Sona closes in to counterattack, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Extend your ranged carry's attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire while they keep attacking.
Sona.escape: Once Sona R Crescendo is down, the risk of being stunned is lower, so look for a moment when Sona steps forward. Sona has no dedicated disengage ability, but she can speed up with Sona E Song of Celerity, so disrupt her movement with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick's knockback and slow as you approach.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to apply her aura, use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and start a trade with their empowered attack. If Sona closes in to counterattack, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. When chasing Sona, decide before Sona E Song of Celerity lets her move away.
Sona.phase: Sona has few stacks early, so pressure her in a battle of attrition alongside your allies. As the game goes on, her stacks and team healing grow stronger, so watch out for extended fights. Milio comes into his own in team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking once you have more items.
Sona.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their attack range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple allies, respond with Milio R Breath of Life. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies.
Sona.watch: If Sona approaches within basic attack range with Sona P Power Chord ready, watch for an empowered attack or slow and create distance in advance. Sona R Crescendo stuns allies in a line, so spread out to either side of your allies when Sona steps forward.

Braum.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Braum’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but tenacity against stuns is also important for Milio, who has no mobility ability.
Braum.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and have them land an empowered basic attack. If Braum engages with Braum W Stand Behind Me or retaliates, knock him away with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick and end the trade.
Braum.escape: The moment Braum W Stand Behind Me is down is your window to close the distance on him. If you don’t need to protect an ally, hit him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick then to knock him away and slow him.
Braum.fight: Start trading by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to empower their next attack. If Braum engages and retaliates, knock him away with the Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick you saved and regain your distance.
Braum.laning: Stand behind allies and minions to avoid the straight angle of Braum Q Winter's Bite. When Braum approaches, help your allies move with Milio E Warm Hugs. Take a direct fight when you can use Milio W Cozy Campfire’s increased range.
Braum.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and avoiding risky deaths rather than starting fights. In mid game, keep your distance and support your allies. In late game, when your shields and healing have grown, look for teamfights where your marksman can keep attacking.
Braum.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer, extend their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick until you need to knock away an enemy who engages on an ally.
Braum.watch: Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite by standing behind minions. If Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, move out of range before the stun stacks build up. Dodge sideways from the straight path of Braum R Glacial Fissure. Milio R Breath of Life cannot cleanse a knock-up, so position yourself before it hits.

Soraka.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to hold on, then choose Mercury's Treads. Most of Soraka's damage is magic, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Soraka's healing becomes a problem in extended fights, consider healing reduction next.
Soraka.combo: Use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have them attack with Milio P Fired Up! applied. After Soraka E Equinox is down, close the distance and use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Soraka if she counterattacks or retreats. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire near your ranged carry when they start attacking.
Soraka.escape: Once Soraka E Equinox has been spent first, you have an opening to engage. If you also dodge Soraka Q Starcall, you can keep up the pressure without letting Soraka heal or gain movement speed. Soraka has no mobility ability, so land Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick after an ally closes the distance.
Soraka.fight: Start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to help them attack. Pressure Soraka into using Soraka W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall so she can't restore her health. When Soraka E Equinox is down and an ally closes in, knock her back and slow her with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Soraka.laning: Don't stand in front; absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs from behind your allies. Soraka W Astral Infusion costs Soraka some of her own health, so pressure your ranged carry to make her heal while dodging Soraka Q Starcall. Take a straight fight when your allies can use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire.
Soraka.phase: Early, Milio should hold on and keep allies alive instead of starting a fight. In the late game, Milio is strong in team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking, so use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire then.
Soraka.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs with the allies who need it. If an ally can reach Soraka, help them target Soraka first instead of continuing to hit an enemy who is being healed. If multiple allies are immobilized, use Milio R Breath of Life. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka Q Starcall hits you, it slows you while Soraka gains healing and movement speed, so use Milio E Warm Hugs before it hits to help your allies dodge. Soraka E Equinox silences and roots inside its zone, so don't step into it as you engage.

Swain.build: Most of Swain's damage is magic, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to hold on, then choose Mercury's Treads. If a long fight makes the healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension a problem, build healing reduction after resistance.
Swain.combo: Use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have them attack to deal Milio P Fired Up!'s bonus damage. If Swain closes in to counterattack, knock him back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first pushes him out of your ally's range and cuts the trade short. Place Milio W Cozy Campfire on the ground near your ranged carry when they start attacking.
Swain.escape: After dodging both the outgoing and returning waves of Swain E Nevermove, pressure him with your allies during the window while the ability is down. Swain has no way to create distance, so closing in then can give you a chance to catch him. Even while engaging, check whether you need Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel an enemy off an ally before using it.
Swain.fight: Start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on your ranged carry so they can attack with the empowered effect. When Swain E Nevermove is down, you have a chance to close the distance, but don't initiate the fight from the front as Milio. If Swain closes in on an ally, peel him off with the saved Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Swain.laning: Keep the wave steady while absorbing poke with Milio E Warm Hugs from behind your allies. Take a straight fight when your ranged carry can use the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire. Avoid the outgoing and returning paths of Swain E Nevermove, and keep your distance so Swain Q Death's Hand's bolts don't overlap.
Swain.phase: Early, before Swain builds stacks, is your chance to pressure him, but it's dangerous for Milio to force an early fight from the front. In the mid game, slow Swain's growth and buy time for Milio's shields and healing to strengthen. In the late game, Swain's accumulated growth makes him harder to catch from the same angle, so set up team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking.
Swain.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their attack range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Swain E Nevermove roots an ally, free them with Milio R Breath of Life. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range and wait for it to end before fighting again.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove also roots when its projectile returns, so stay out of its path until it disappears completely. If rooted, you can be pulled in and hit by his follow-up, so dodge in advance with Milio E Warm Hugs's movement speed. If an ally is rooted, free them with Milio R Breath of Life. More of Swain Q Death's Hand's bolts overlap and hit you at close range, so keep your distance.

Taric.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. The damage from Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle is magic, so Milio should build magic resistance first.
Taric.combo: Use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to start a trade with a basic attack empowered by Milio P Fired Up!. Dodge Taric E Dazzle sideways, and if Taric closes in to counterattack, peel him off with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Extend your ranged carry's attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire while they attack.
Taric.escape: After Taric E Dazzle is down, you have a chance to step forward and use your range. Taric has no ability to create distance, but don't go deep first; interrupt him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick when he closes in on an ally.
Taric.fight: After Taric E Dazzle misses, use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and start a trade within attack range. If Taric closes in, knock him back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to stop him from following up with basic attacks. When you see the cast animation for Taric R Cosmic Radiance, decide whether to retreat or disrupt the enemy carry, then attack again after the damage immunity ends.
Taric.laning: Absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs from behind your allies, and trade during the window after dodging Taric E Dazzle. Don't use Milio W Cozy Campfire early just to heal; activate it when your ranged carry starts attacking. Keep your distance so Taric can't reach minions to land Taric P Bravado's basic attacks.
Taric.phase: Taric P Bravado's basic attacks are threatening in early melee trades, so protect your allies and avoid forcing fights. In the mid game, take fights when you have the range advantage from Milio W Cozy Campfire, and attack after Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity ends. In the late game, look for team fights where Milio's stronger shields and healing help your ranged carry keep attacking.
Taric.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Taric E Dazzle catches multiple allies, free them with Milio R Breath of Life, and use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active, manage their position with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick's forced movement and slow, then attack again when the immunity ends.
Taric.watch: When you see the tell for Taric E Dazzle, move sideways to dodge it. Don't commit all your attacks while Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active.

Thresh.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. Thresh's main damage is magic, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance. Also get tenacity, since the attacks that follow a catch are dangerous.
Thresh.combo: Use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their next attack deals bonus damage. If Thresh closes in to counterattack, knock him back and slow him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first pushes him out of your ally's range and cuts the trade short.
Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, you have a chance to close the distance. Look for a window before Thresh W Dark Passage comes back up, and if Thresh reaches an ally, peel him off with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Don't assume that only Thresh Q Death Sentence being down means he has no other way to move.
Thresh.fight: Start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to empower their next attack with bonus damage. After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, close the distance, but save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to knock Thresh back if he reaches an ally. Give your ranged carry a range advantage by activating Milio W Cozy Campfire when they start attacking.
Thresh.laning: Milio has no mobility ability, so stay behind your allies and only step forward after securing vision in the bushes. Move side to side to dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence, and help allies change direction again when they step forward to last-hit. When Thresh walks forward to collect a soul, start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally.
Thresh.phase: Early, focus on keeping allies alive and dodging Thresh's catches instead of starting fights. In the mid game, keep Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick and Milio E Warm Hugs available to prepare for Thresh's engage. As you build items, Milio's shields and healing grow stronger, and his peak is in late-game team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking.
Thresh.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Thresh reaches an ally, peel him off with the saved Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If an ally is immobilized, Milio R Breath of Life provides healing and cleansing. Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove the knockback or pull from Thresh E Flay, so avoid that positioning in advance.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence leads into a dash after the stun, so move sideways when you see him raise his hook. Avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay doesn't pull you toward them. Apply Milio E Warm Hugs before the hit so its movement speed helps with dodging.

Velkoz.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. Most of Vel'Koz's damage is magic, and Milio has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray deal true damage that resistance can't block, so your priority is to avoid being hit by a sequence of abilities.
Velkoz.combo: Start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have them attack with Milio P Fired Up! applied. If the enemy closes in to counterattack, knock them back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Using Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first can push the enemy out of your ally's range and cut the trade short. If you close in after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, you can catch him with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, you have a chance to approach. However, if you get very close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back, so make sure it's down before going in. If you have been hit by a sequence of Vel'Koz's abilities and stacks have built up, don't engage; back away and let the stacks wear off.
Velkoz.fight: Instead of starting the fight, use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and help them attack. After Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, Vel'Koz has fewer ways to counterattack, giving you a chance to close in with an ally. If an enemy reaches an ally, knock them back with the saved Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Velkoz.laning: Keep the wave steady while using Milio E Warm Hugs from behind your allies to absorb Vel'Koz's poke. When you need to dodge Vel'Koz's skillshots, apply Milio E Warm Hugs before they hit rather than afterward to provide movement speed. Don't use Milio W Cozy Campfire early just to heal; activate it when your ranged carry starts attacking.
Velkoz.phase: Early, Milio has low kill participation and damage, so focus on keeping allies alive while enduring Vel'Koz's poke. In the mid game, clear vision around the river and tri-brush to make it harder for Vel'Koz to step forward and poke. In the late game, look for team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking with the range increase from Milio W Cozy Campfire.
Velkoz.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their attack range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs as needed.
