If Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick can reach, interrupt the channel; if you can't, move behind a wall to break vision. Milio R Breath of Life cannot cleanse the knock-up from Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, so use it for healing and tenacity when multiple allies are caught.
Velkoz.watch: With Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, watch for the split beams too; don't just dodge sideways—move toward Vel'Koz or behind where the beam passed. If Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption also hit in quick succession, Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so move behind minions if stacks have built up. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, first check whether Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick can interrupt the channel.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. Xerath's main damage is magic, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Use Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, then have them attack to deal Milio P Fired Up!'s bonus damage. As your ally starts hitting the enemy, activate Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their range. If the enemy counterattacks and closes in, knock them back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to end the trade.
Xerath.escape: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, you have a window to close in. You can dodge sideways and approach while Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. When Xerath casts Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, he can't move, so take a position to dodge first or engage on him there.
Xerath.fight: Start a trade by using Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally to empower their next attack. While your ally attacks, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire. If an enemy reaches your ally, knock them back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, your ally has a chance to close in and fight.
Xerath.laning: Keep the wave steady and absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs from behind your allies. Don't risk too much trying to dodge every Xerath poke; endure it while avoiding the heavy damage. When Xerath runs out of mana, push the lane and call your jungler. Don't use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick for lane poke; save it to protect your allies.
Xerath.phase: Early, watch out for Xerath's long-range poke and focus on keeping your allies alive. In the mid game, look for moments when Xerath is out of mana or Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Once you have more items, Milio's shields and healing grow stronger, so look for late-game team fights where your ranged carry can keep attacking.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay behind your main damage dealer and use Milio W Cozy Campfire to extend their range, then share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns an ally, you can free them with Milio R Breath of Life; use it to heal when multiple allies have taken damage. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel an enemy engager off an ally.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so don't let your guard down behind them. When Xerath takes a charging stance, use Milio E Warm Hugs's movement speed to dodge widely to the side. Be especially wary of Xerath E Shocking Orb, as its stun can leave you open to a sequence of attacks.

Zilean.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance. Tenacity also helps when you’re caught by slows and stuns.
Zilean.combo: For a trade, cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally, let them make their empowered next attack, then knock the enemy back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick when they close in to retaliate. Don’t cast Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first and knock them out of your ally’s attack range.
Zilean.escape: After Zilean has spent his bomb combo using Zilean Q Time Bomb and Zilean W Rewind, you have a chance to close the gap. Zilean has no mobility ability, but Zilean E Time Warp can slow one person, so don't go in alone ahead of your allies; use Milio E Warm Hugs' movement speed to help allies approach.
Zilean.fight: Milio shouldn’t stand in front. When an enemy gets onto an ally, knock them back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
Zilean.laning: Stay behind allies, absorb poke with Milio E Warm Hugs, and keep the wave stable. Don't cast Milio W Cozy Campfire early just for the healing; activate it to extend your allied marksman's range when they start attacking. When Zilean's first bomb attaches, spread apart so the stun doesn't catch multiple allies together.
Zilean.phase: In the late game, Milio excels in teamfights where Milio W Cozy Campfire helps allied marksmen keep attacking.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay behind your team's main damage dealer, extend their range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Zilean Q Time Bomb's combo stuns several allies, use Milio R Breath of Life. Use Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies. While a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift is reviving, don't unload your abilities; prepare for immediately after they revive.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs attach to the same target. When the first bomb attaches, move away from allies and out of its blast radius. Use Milio E Warm Hugs’ movement speed in advance to help dodge the second bomb.

Zyra.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Milio has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of persistent crowd control, fit Mikael’s Blessing between your core items.
Zyra.combo: Cast Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally and let them use Milio P Fired Up!’s bonus damage with a basic attack. If Zyra closes in to retaliate, knock her back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to end the trade. If you cast Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick first, Zyra may be knocked out of your ally’s attack range.
Zyra.escape: After Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, that's your chance to close the gap. Zyra has no mobility ability, but Milio has no ability to escape on his own either, so move with your allies and hold Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to respond to a counterattack.
Zyra.fight: Start a trade by casting Milio E Warm Hugs on an ally so their attack carries the passive damage. Help your ally attack during the window after Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, then knock Zyra back with Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick if she closes in to retaliate. Activate Milio W Cozy Campfire when your allied marksman starts attacking.
Zyra.laning: Milio has a hard time fighting up front early, so stay behind allies, use Milio E Warm Hugs to absorb poke, and keep the wave stable. Clear seeds when it’s safe to step on them, but back off if Zyra tries to grow them with an ability, then approach again. Briefly retreat from areas where many plants have grown and wait for them to disappear.
Zyra.phase: Early on, Milio should focus on keeping allies alive and avoiding Zyra E Grasping Roots rather than starting fights. In the mid game, avoid areas where Zyra has been set up for a while; move to another objective, then fight on fresh terrain. In the late game, Milio’s shields and healing are stronger, so focus on teamfights where you protect allied marksmen and help them keep attacking.
Zyra.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s main damage dealer, extend their attack range with Milio W Cozy Campfire, and share Milio E Warm Hugs. If Zyra E Grasping Roots catches several allies, cleanse and heal them with Milio R Breath of Life, but it cannot cleanse the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns. Save Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick to peel enemies off allies.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, it can lead into plant damage and the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns, so dodge E by moving sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, use Milio E Warm Hugs' movement speed to walk out of its area. Don't fight near clusters of plants in an area where Zyra has stayed for a long time.
